newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Romania's President Emil Constantinescu has talks with parties represented in parliament on the Romanian-Ukrainian treaty, initialled on May 3 in Kiev.

* Members of Romania's upper Senate discussed prospects of developing the domestic capital market on Wednesday. State radio quoted the U.S. ambassador to Bucharest Alfred Moses, as saying during the meeting that the Romanian capital market is the most developed in the Central and east European region. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
